excerpt: MoEDAL... deployed close to LHCb at Point 8... 125 plastic Nuclear Track Detector (NTD) stacks with a total of 47m2 of deployed plastic... approximately one tonne of trapping detectors... TimePix pixel detectors... 2010: MoEDAL approved as the LHC's 7th experiment. 2021: MAPP detector upgrade approved for Run 3 preparation.
